Parent: zaq-ic9.14. Read the parent contract and inherited policies before work. This task stays blocked until its recorded prerequisite is complete.

Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add:
Wire trusted actual Jido request ID/runtime incarnation into selection effects and maintain one authoritative collection in execution state. Extend Factory/context only if discovery proves required; StreamEvents transports accepted changes/final snapshot. Serialize conflicting operations deterministically, deduplicate invocation replay, reject stale effects and clear failed/cancelled requests. Keep sensitive effects and Records outside public projections and persisted traces.

Tests to add before implementation:
Real runtime integration/property tests for add A/add B/remove A across iterations, same-request steering, new/queued-request isolation, runtime replacement, replayed add after remove, concurrent conflicts, stale events, terminal freezing, cancellation/failure, and trace/history/public projection privacy.

Branches/paths validated:
Cover success, invalid input/authorization, lifecycle and propagation paths relevant to this step; preserve the parent's add/remove/replace, atomicity, request isolation and privacy invariants.

Mocking plan:
Keep internal ZAQ and Jido boundaries real where supported; mock only external model/provider/network edges. No shared global test configuration. Discovery must identify any hard constraint before test-only abstractions are added.

Documentations to update for both code and docs/ related content:
Record evidence, decisions and validation in this issue. Update affected module docs and docs/services/agent.md with implementation; final documentation consistency is checked by the validation task. Do not describe proposed behavior as shipped.

Action reuse assessment:
Extend supported Jido lifecycle and StreamEvents integration; reuse native context/effects rather than inventing a second catalog or global state. Private lifecycle helpers are local-only because they enforce execution ownership rather than expose independent business operations. No model-controlled request IDs.

Gates:
Follow docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md and docs/testing-approach.md. Discovery must resolve unknown contracts and finalize this step before coding. Existing test behavior changes require explicit human approval. No commit/push/merge implied.

comments.text: Implemented one authoritative selection in Jido Agent state, scoped by native super-generated request ID and owning runtime PID. Native effects bind invocation ID in Factory.after_tool_call; ordered completions fold add/remove/replace, deduplicate replay after removal, fence request/incarnation/sequence, freeze completion and discard failures/cancellation. Cancelled worker terminal acknowledgement (including racing completion) still reaches native lifecycle cleanup while selection stays failed. Factory strips sensitive selection args/results/effects and checkpoint tokens before native traces/thread projection; direct private checkpoint snapshot reaches only matching StreamEvents request/PID and only successful completed results expose files. New model-edge scripts execute real Factory/Jido/Action; tests cover B-only, parallel conflicts, replace/clear, active steering, busy request isolation, real provider failure, cancellation/fresh requests, replay and foreign/stale/post-terminal events, privacy and incomplete/error stream snapshots. Focused regression suite 108 passed; latest additional focused suite 10 passed (1 property,9 tests); mix q passed. Reuse assessment unchanged: local-only pure transition helper for runtime ownership, existing native hooks/transport and no global catalog or delivery implementation.

Authorized cleanup plan (safe-refactor): owner remains Jido agent.state; Factory becomes thin native callbacks into AttachmentSelection.Runtime. Scope only enabled requests. Replace synthetic checkpoint/sequence rewriting with one tagged private message to existing request sink before native completion; StreamEvents drains exact request/PID on terminal, exposes only success. Same sender ordering preserves delivery without querying mutable runtime state. Keep deterministic fold/replay, busy-request isolation, cancellation cleanup and trace redaction. Correct signed-identity fixtures to real seals and remove unsigned fallback. User agreed to review findings cleanup including test correction; adapt implementation-specific transport expectations without weakening behavioral assertions. Files: Factory, AttachmentSelection, new local Runtime adapter, StreamEvents, focused tests and agent docs. Validate focused runtime/action/stream/delivery suites and mix q, no precommit. Rollback criterion: any lifecycle/privacy regression or weaker test assertions; no new state process, framework, delivery logic or E2E. UX gate stays open.

Cleanup complete: Factory additions reduced from 176 to 25 lines; attachment-specific hooks delegated to AttachmentSelection.Runtime, no state initialized or worker-event filtering for disabled requests. Removed synthetic checkpoint/ID construction and terminal sequence rewriting; exact request/PID tagged final message is consumed by StreamEvents at termination using existing sink and sender ordering. Signed reducer tests now use valid provenance, distinguish providers/configs; unsigned identity fallback removed. New real disabled-tool regression retains native checkpoint tokens, two fresh requests, no selection state. Existing cancellation/replay/steering/privacy/delivery assertions preserved; native contiguous event sequences asserted. Focused 21 checks passed; broader 18-file regression 307 passed (6 doctests,11 properties,290 tests), seed592963; mix q and diff check passed. New unused-variable compile warning fixed before q/broader regression; only preexisting license_manager configuration warning remains. No precommit/commit/push/merge/sync. UX acceptance remains pending.
